title: Glen Powell's Luke Combs Concert Moment Helped Inspire The Comeback King
excerpt:
A viral 2024 concert appearance helped shape Powell's country-music role.
The Judd Apatow comedy is scheduled for February 2027.
body_md:
Glen Powell is set to play a country singer in The Comeback King, a music-centered comedy developed with Judd Apatow. The role takes him into a different performance territory after recent action and adventure projects.

Part of the inspiration came from a Luke Combs concert in New York in summer 2024. Powell appeared onstage alongside fellow Twisters cast members, and a video of the moment circulated widely on social media.

The film also features country artists including Miranda Lambert, Jelly Roll, Brad Paisley and Shaboozey. Its reported theatrical release date is February 5, 2027, subject to the usual possibility of scheduling changes.
